valuation_note: 主采用作者冻结base经营及五年实际普通D加同状态经济Y5，中心45.536497895251834元。核心端点为同经营/同D/同股数下ke10%和8%，原值40.05193971515188及52.7690014914094；PPE维护1.2/0.8倍DA分别41.7067027180252/49.366293072478484仅隔离诊断。终端g2%并扣必要再投资，主法经营尾部占核心现值46.91%。辅助零增长OE与有限资本/周转桥给38.07672901338339元持有口径，差16.38%，不平均；辅助的有限周转释放并非保守保证。保守及改善经营另列，特别本金释放仅条件诊断。当前即刻resource48.64534888298759与实际持有中心的差来自五年低收益留存，不再加任意本金折扣。 IGCT1.9207亿元认缴为受控子公司内部资金迁移，原base/core状态可额外圈定上市归属1.49545702亿元而不变原D；初始出资完全损失0.1123809413元/股仅极端诊断，不再乘67%或重复扣集团现金，未计专属增量利润/技术溢价。
return_model_note: 五个滚动年截至2027—2031年10月31日，年末付款归集近似，人民币税前；D按归普通股经营利润及税后金融收益40%普通派息并经母子现金/RE约束，非董事会承诺。0.68元末期及0.46元中期均于起点前实施，不重复纳入未来D。Y5为分配后普通股F5加剩余经营C及正常尾值，非第五年清算或特别派息；ke10%/8%端点共用相同base经营及D。普通股数固定1,330,703,412，已注销H股纳入起点，无未来回购/发行/未证稀释预算；NCI与债务已在归属现金桥内不再全额扣一次。母体及税池为聚合预算而非逐法人法律证明。 IGCT资金圈定在既存聚合子现金/RE下支持原D，实际成立/实缴/外付与单户现金位置仍未知；内部注资不记集团外流。

budget.units: source_facts in CNY yuan; budget amounts explicitly suffix _bn in CNY billion; ratios decimal

source_facts.revenue_9m_bn_note: Original business-table unit is RMB100m; code must divide by 10 to convert these values to RMBbn. Field name retained as source-table token, not already bn.

source_mapping.q3_*: Original S_Q3 pp5-9, balance sheet as of September 30, not October cash statement
source_mapping.october_dividend: S_H1DIV implementation, payment October 16 before cutoff
source_mapping.source_revenue_table: S_Q3 p5 RMB100m cumulative; never Q3 single quarter

common_budget.first_forecast_label: Rolling holder year 1 ends 2027-10-31; full-year 2027 operating run-rate proxy; no claim it is an audited FY2027 forecast
common_budget.q4_basis: Explicit analyst delivery budget after 9M actual; rail seasonality supported FY25/FY22; not 4/3 annualization. Sensitivity on first full-year run rate kept separate.
common_budget.classification_basis: H1 exact classification constrains Q3 totals, not exact Q3 disclosure. Nonfinancial-long includes contract assets, prepaid construction and tax assets. Restricted cash retained as recoverable operating asset, not destroyed. October dividend removes cash and declared liability together.
common_budget.nci_financial_basis: Unknown subsidiary cash location; 3% is ownership-allocation budget, not governance haircut. Most large deposits sit at parent; semiconductor ownership22.14% minority applied to its separate operating flow. Show range.
common_budget.ownership_basis: Semi exact legal share; other aggregates are explicit budgets for non-wholly-owned rail/city and nested auto JVs, not invented legal shares. Auto70% bounded60%-80%; rail97% bounded95%-99%. No minor legal-entity precision claimed.
common_budget.parent_fraction_basis: Economic allocation of common attributable profit/cash to direct parent vs subsidiaries, not disclosed segment. Parent is major rail/equipment operating company; semi and marine mainly subsidiaries. Test cash-payability rather than pretending all group cash immediate parent cash.
common_budget.subs_re_basis: Bounded planning reserve, not statutory actual consolidated RE; legal limits modeled at aggregate common-share subsidiaries only, exclude NCI. Subject to actual-major-subsidiary profitable pool; low4/high8 bn sensitivity if binding.
common_budget.settlement_basis: Normal additional net parent payments to subsidiaries, reducing parent and increasing subsidiary cash; not group cost or legal setoff. Not wholesale immediate settlement of all old balances.
common_budget.debt_basis: Rounded Q3/H1 bridge covering identified related financing and bank debt excluding lease; refinance ordinary remainder, not all liabilities payable immediately. Debt already in equity cash, no separate terminal full debt subtraction.
common_budget.da_basis: Annual budgeting anchored H1 detailed DA, with Q3 new-line transfers; not automatic exact twice H1. ROU operating-route adjustment and separate land/software/technology buckets.
common_budget.growth_capital_basis: Analyst capital intensity. Semiconductor existing built capacity reduces near-term incremental cash; future growth/maintenance still required. Not measured realized project ROIC.
common_budget.commitment_basis: H1 commitment2.143bn and equipment payable1.003bn rolled to cutoff using known9M capex direction; 1.60/0.75 are estimates not Q3 actual. First creates new capacity as paid; second settles already booked asset, no second asset creation. Unrecognized existing-project cash replaces first portion of capacity-linked growth capex, not added twice.
common_budget.tax_basis: Cash tax bridge separate current/deferred and tax-payable timing. Extra deduction only eligible expenses. 2028 semi extra120% ceases; ordinary expense deduction stays. Software refund cash assumed same year; capital grant amort noncash removed from C.
common_budget.aux_basis: Current built run-rate normalized independently from FY25/9M26, no growth and no main Y6 copying. Same tax expiry and steady maintenance; no existing-project growth profit free of capital. Separate normalized profitability parameters below.

conservative.mechanism: Rail procurement/collection pressure persists; semiconductor price and ramp disappoint, no automatic full recovery; ordinary refinancing remains available.

base.mechanism: Rail keeps reliability/system position with modest growth; IGBT commercial, SiC gradual; auto growth but competition; partial working-capital recovery and gradual excess-cash return.

improvement.mechanism: Observed price letters convert to realized price, yield and validation support built capacity; no free capital, tax or NCI exclusion; faster but gradual cash return.

details.development_transfer_basis: Explicit timing budget: near-complete projects at H1, half current development balance transfers in first rolling year then prior balance next year; not source-disclosed exact transfer. Development itself is not amortized before transfer.

policy.core_value_adoption: No automatic selection before authorized numerical materiality review; show resource and policy values separately; D/Y5 always same ordinary-policy state

igct_bridge_spec.scope: Existing saved-state cash reservation and rights diagnostic; no operating producer or new project profit
igct_bridge_spec.trigger_condition: JV subscription not yet implemented at cutoff; retain the full committed contribution as unavailable for upstream, without assuming payment date
igct_bridge_spec.cash_test: After every original paid dividend and original upstream, common subsidiary financial cash must exceed original subsidiary floor plus common reserve; NCI financial cash must exceed NCI reserve. Parent existing cash floor and RE stay checked. Include original opening state and all10years for base, ke_lower, ke_higher, maintenance_lower, maintenance_higher and base auxiliary.
igct_bridge_spec.parent_and_group_mapping: Reservation occurs inside common-attributable subsidiaries, not a second parent cash cost. Actual semi-to-JV payment is internal consolidated transfer. No subtraction from group closing cash, no new borrowing, no extra financial income or JV value.
igct_bridge_spec.rights_diagnostic: Maximum initial subscribed-cash loss exposure to listed shareholders is192070000*0.7786; do not multiply67%again. Per share divide1330703412. This is an extreme total-loss diagnosis of this initial contribution only, not a forecast or bound on all future enterprise risks. Capital exchanged for technical/equity rights is not automatically a permanent loss. No added technical asset value or extra project earnings.
igct_bridge_spec.technical_rights_boundary: Separate contract86m assets from economic realizability; project consideration paid may be recoverable0..paid capital in a finite diagnostic, never added on top of already preserved cash or existing operating profits.
unknowns: incremental spending outside aggregate research/capital budgets
igct_bridge_spec.no_claim: Cash sufficiency under aggregate budgets is not legal permission or a statement that the project is explicitly contained in original forecast. If already paid/spent at9/30, disclosed cash/assets already include it; do not deduct subscription again.
